title: Исход 30 — Exodus 30
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Сделай из ___ жертвенник для возжигания благовоний.
cases.translation: Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of / from a material) takes the genitive → акации.

cases.sentence: Поставь жертвенник перед ___, за которой находится ковчег свидетельства.
cases.translation: Put the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the covenant.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (in front of) takes the instrumental → завесой.

cases.sentence: Поставь его между шатром собрания и жертвенником и налей в него ___.
cases.translation: Put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and pour water into it.
cases.explain: The partitive genitive after налей (pour some water) → воды.

cases.sentence: Поставь его между шатром собрания и ___.
cases.translation: Put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) takes the instrumental → жертвенником.

cases.sentence: Пусть в грядущих ___ благовония возжигаются перед Господом постоянно.
cases.translation: Let incense be burned before the Lord continually throughout the generations to come.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in / throughout" a time takes the prepositional → поколениях (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Пусть Аарон и его сыновья моют из него свои ___ и ноги.
cases.translation: Let Aaron and his sons wash their hands and feet from it.
cases.explain: Руки is the direct object of моют (wash); for this inanimate feminine plural the accusative equals the nominative → руки.

cases.sentence: Пусть каждый из них заплатит ___ при пересчете выкуп за жизнь.
cases.translation: Let each of them pay the Lord a ransom for his life when they are counted.
cases.explain: The dative marks the recipient of заплатить ("pay to the Lord") → Господу.

cases.translation: …put it before the ark of the covenant in the Tent of Meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → шатре.

reading.ru: Сделай из акации жертвенник для возжигания благовоний.
reading.question: From what material was the incense altar to be made?
reading.explain: The altar for burning incense was to be made of acacia wood.

reading.ru: Поставь его между шатром собрания и жертвенником и налей в него воды.
reading.question: Where was the bronze basin to be placed?
options: Between the Tent of Meeting and the altar
reading.correct: Between the Tent of Meeting and the altar
reading.explain: The basin was to be set between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and filled with water.

reading.ru: Пусть Аарон и его сыновья моют из него свои руки и ноги.
reading.question: What were Aaron and his sons to wash from the basin?
reading.explain: Aaron and his sons were to wash their hands and their feet from the basin.

reading.ru: Богатые не должны давать больше половины шекеля, а бедные не должны давать меньше, когда вы будете делать приношение Господу, чтобы выкупить свою жизнь.
reading.question: How much were the rich and the poor to give?
options: Neither more nor less than half a shekel
reading.correct: Neither more nor less than half a shekel
reading.explain: The rich were not to give more and the poor not less than half a shekel.

reading.ru: Всякий, кто сделает сходное благовоние или помажет им кого-то, кроме священника, будет исторгнут из своего народа.
reading.question: What was the penalty for making similar anointing oil or using it improperly?
options: To be cut off from his people
To pay a fine of silver
To be exiled for a year
reading.correct: To be cut off from his people
reading.explain: Whoever made a like mixture or anointed an unauthorized person was to be cut off from his people.

reading.ru: Раз в год Аарон будет очищать жертвенник, нанося кровь очистительные жертвы за грех на его рога.
reading.question: How often was Aaron to cleanse the altar?
reading.explain: Aaron was to make atonement on the altar's horns once a year with the blood of the sin offering.
